thread:
kevin: Heads up — last two nightly eval runs didn't start on the GH Actions schedule. PR gating also hit 'eval-runner-timeout' twice. Anyone seen this?

sara: yup, noticed this morning. :eyes: saw the scheduled workflow log show 'no runners available' around 03:00 UTC.

kevin: paste from the runner log: ```Job: eval-nightly
Runner labels requested: gpu,self-hosted
Error: No runner with labels 'gpu' available```

joyce: that matches what infra warned about — hosted ubuntu-latest won't satisfy gpu label and our self-hosted pool is saturated. We should avoid asking GH for GPU capacity for heavy nightly shards.

kevin: we recently switched to a matrix to parallelize shards, maybe oversubscribed the pool.

lina: @joyce can we route heavy scheduled jobs to Buildkite (dedicated GPU fleet) and keep GHA for PR smoke? Less moving parts for the PR gate and cheaper for nightlies.

joyce: agree. two quick options: 1) have the GH schedule trigger a repository_dispatch that Buildkite picks up, or 2) convert the GH scheduled job to a lightweight dispatcher that calls a Buildkite trigger token. Either avoids GH self-hosted GPU pressure.

raul: another thing — PR gating has flaky failures that look like artifact dedupe issues. Sometimes the gating job picks up stale metrics from previous runs if artifact uploads overlap. Need dedupe by commit sha and stricter TTLs.

sara: also consider adding `concurrency: group: eval-${{ github.ref }}-${{ github.sha }}` and `cancel-in-progress: true` to avoid overlapping runs for the same PR/branch. That helped with other flaky matrix jobs.

kevin: tried concurrency, but when no runners are available GHA still queues the job and we get long delays. Proposed short plan: 1) change scheduled nightly to trigger Buildkite for heavy GPU evals, 2) PR gate: shrink shard count and run a lightweight smoke eval (full run on merge/nightly), 3) implement artifact dedupe keyed by commit sha + TTL, 4) add an early 'runner-health' step that fails fast and notifies #eng-ml so we don't wait 30m in queue.

ci-bot: Alert: scheduled workflow 'eval-nightly' failed to start at 2026-03-18T03:00:00Z — reason: no self-hosted runners available.

joyce: i'll open a small PR to replace the schedule job with a repo_dispatch -> Buildkite trigger + add concurrency to the PR workflow. @kevin can you add the artifact dedupe snippet?

kevin: on it. i'll add a dedupe script that names artifacts `eval-${{ github.sha }}-${{ matrix.shard }}` and sets TTL=48h. also add a tiny `check-runners` step: ```- name: runner-health
  run: |
    if curl -fsS http://runners.internal/health | grep -q \"ok\"; then echo ok; else echo \"no runners\"; exit 1; fi```

sara: nice. after the PR lands we should run a couple of manual scheduled dispatches to verify no regressions.

kevin: thanks — pairing with @joyce on the Buildkite trigger later today. will post PR link. :thumbsup:
